new_items.why: Names the Taylor and Maclaurin series while separating formal definition from convergence and representation.
States exactly when a smooth function equals its Taylor series and gives a uniform remainder criterion.
Adds the canonical two-sided flat function whose convergent Maclaurin series does not represent it.
Adds the missing logarithmic asymptotic of harmonic partial sums without duplicating harmonic-series divergence.
Calibrates the analytic unit-circle parameter as geometric radian arc length.
Proves that the analytic sine and cosine recover opposite-over-hypotenuse and adjacent-over-hypotenuse.
Collects the standard expansions under the Maclaurin name at the first dependency-legal page and proves the missing generalized binomial family.
